decisions.statement: Characters and companions come back ordered by the sort order each row carries.
A row carrying no sort order comes back last.
A row whose eso character id is no text is left out.
A build page absent leaves the character with no target build hash.
A build hash that is no text reads as no build hash.
One build page is read once however many characters name that build.
A live build is read only where the live build hash is asked for.
A caller may hand in the reader that reads the pages.
No build hash is decoded here.

definition: an account's target builds read from its pages and the gear those builds want
